stem: The outgoing technician reports 'pump acting weird' but gives no asset ID, time, readings, or effect on the crop. What should the incoming technician do?
choices: Ask targeted clarifying questions and cross-check the affected asset/status before assuming ownership
Accept the statement as sufficient because the issue was mentioned
Ignore it until the alarm returns
rationale: Two-way handoff and cross-checking help convert vague information into actionable, reliable continuity information.
